# vercel_custom_alert_rule (Resource)

Creates a project-scoped custom Vercel alert rule using the Alerts v3 API. Supports threshold and anomaly conditions on a metric or same-event ratio. Custom alerts must be enabled for the team. Manage Slack and webhook links with `vercel_alert_rule_slack_notification` and `vercel_alert_rule_webhook_notification`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "vercel_project" "checkout" {
  name = "checkout"
}

resource "vercel_custom_alert_rule" "checkout_errors" {
  name       = "Checkout server errors"
  project_id = data.vercel_project.checkout.id
  severity   = "high"

  evaluation = {
    window = "5m"
    query = jsonencode({
      metrics = {
        errors = {
          metric      = "vercel.request.count"
          aggregation = "count"
          filter      = "httpStatus >= 500"
        }
      }
      outputs = ["errors"]
    })
  }

  trigger = {
    type      = "threshold"
    output    = "errors"
    operator  = "gt"
    threshold = 20
  }

  notification_settings = {
    enable_team_owner_notifications = true
  }
}

resource "vercel_alert_rule_slack_notification" "checkout_errors" {
  alert_rule_id    = vercel_custom_alert_rule.checkout_errors.id
  slack_channel_id = "C0123456789"
}

resource "vercel_alert_rule_webhook_notification" "checkout_errors" {
  alert_rule_id = vercel_custom_alert_rule.checkout_errors.id
  webhook_id    = vercel_webhook.alerts.id
}

resource "vercel_webhook" "alerts" {
  endpoint = "https://example.com/vercel-alerts"
  events   = ["alerts.triggered"]
}
```

## Query requirements

Run `vc metrics schema <metric-or-prefix>` before choosing metric IDs, aggregations, dimensions, and filter fields. The API validates queries against the current metric catalog.

Custom alerts must be enabled for the team. Creating a rule or changing its project, evaluation, or trigger requires Observability Plus on the resulting project. Metadata and notification updates send only the changed fields and do not rewrite the query.

An evaluation uses one metric with its alias as the sole output, or exactly two metrics with a division formula named `formula` and `formula` as the sole output. Both ratio operands must resolve to the same underlying event. Optional `groupBy` contains exactly one dimension. Query-level and metric-level `filter` fields use KQL.

Use `per = "second"` or `normalize = "percent"` only with `count` or `sum`; these modifiers cannot be combined. The `unique` aggregation requires dimensions and accepts neither modifier. Metric availability and query compatibility are enforced by the API.

For example, a ratio query can be authored with `jsonencode`:

```hcl
query = jsonencode({
  metrics = {
    errors = { metric = "vercel.request.count", aggregation = "count", filter = "httpStatus >= 500" }
    requests = { metric = "vercel.request.count", aggregation = "count" }
  }
  formulas = { formula = "errors / requests" }
  outputs = ["formula"]
})
```

The trigger output must match the query's sole output. Threshold triggers require `operator` and `threshold`; anomaly triggers require `standard_deviations`. A minimum floor is allowed for anomaly triggers, or ratio threshold triggers with `gt` or `gte`. Its output is the primitive metric alias or ratio numerator.

The provider retains configured query text when the API canonicalizes filters and detects subsequent remote query changes. Imported rules use the canonical API representation; use that representation in configuration to obtain an empty plan. Legacy custom rules with `querySupported: false` cannot be imported into this resource.

## Schema

### Required

- `evaluation` (Attributes) The metric query and evaluation window. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--evaluation))
- `name` (String) A human-readable name for the alert rule.
- `project_id` (String) The project evaluated by this custom rule. Creating a rule or changing its query requires Observability Plus on this project.
- `severity` (String) Severity assigned when the rule triggers: `low`, `medium`, or `high`. Critical severity is assigned only by a completed agent investigation.
- `trigger` (Attributes) A fixed threshold or anomaly condition on the query output. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--trigger))

### Optional

- `agent_triage_enabled` (Boolean) When true, publish notifications only after the alert is classified as Critical. Defaults to false.
- `investigation_prompt` (String) Optional guidance stored for agent investigations. The API currently stores this prompt without passing it to the investigation workflow. Removing it clears the stored prompt.
- `notification_settings` (Attributes) Notification delivery settings stored on the rule. Notification destination links are managed with the `vercel_alert_rule_slack_notification` and `vercel_alert_rule_webhook_notification` resources. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--notification_settings))
- `team_id` (String) The ID of the team that owns the alert rule. Required if a default team is not configured in the provider.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (Number) Creation time as a Unix epoch timestamp in milliseconds.
- `id` (String) The ID of the alert rule.
- `updated_at` (Number) Last update time as a Unix epoch timestamp in milliseconds.

<a id="nestedatt--evaluation"></a>
### Nested Schema for `evaluation`

Required:

- `query` (String) The Alerts v3 query as a JSON object. Prefer `jsonencode(...)`. Use one metric without formulas, or two metrics with a division formula named `formula`. Discover supported metrics with `vc metrics schema <metric-or-prefix>`.
- `window` (String) Aggregation granularity and detection cadence: `5m`, `15m`, `1h`, or `1d`.


<a id="nestedatt--trigger"></a>
### Nested Schema for `trigger`

Required:

- `output` (String) The query's single output alias.
- `type` (String) The condition type: `threshold` or `anomaly`.

Optional:

- `minimum` (Attributes) Optional evaluation floor. Allowed for anomalies or ratio thresholds using `gt` or `gte`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--trigger--minimum))
- `operator` (String) Required for threshold triggers; omitted for anomaly triggers.
- `standard_deviations` (Number) Required anomaly threshold in standard deviations, at least 0.1.
- `threshold` (Number) Required numeric threshold for threshold triggers. Zero is supported.

<a id="nestedatt--trigger--minimum"></a>
### Nested Schema for `trigger.minimum`

Required:

- `output` (String) The primitive metric alias, or ratio numerator alias.
- `threshold` (Number) Non-negative floor below which the rule is not evaluated.



<a id="nestedatt--notification_settings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `notification_settings`

Optional:

- `enable_team_owner_notifications` (Boolean)
- `incident_io_routing_key` (String)

## Import

```shell
# Include the team ID, or omit it when the provider has a default team.
terraform import vercel_custom_alert_rule.checkout_errors team_123/ar_123
terraform import vercel_custom_alert_rule.checkout_errors ar_123
```
